title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
Jurisdiction: Tamil Nadu, India
Category: State health insurance
Type: Insurance / Health Assurance
Details: Tamil Nadu programme providing cashless treatment for covered procedures at empanelled hospitals, subject to packages and current rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Tamil Nadu resident family; official eligibility page states annual family income below ₹1,20,000. Family-member inclusion is subject to scheme rules and ration-card records.
Individual Enrolment Required: True

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Income certificate, family ration card and Aadhaar are listed in official eligibility guidance. Additional proof may be requested.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Visit the designated CMCHIS card-issuing/enrolment centre at the District Collector's Office with required documents; consult the official portal.
Official Portal: https://www.cmchistn.com/
